155 rows · precedence a–e per MIL-STD-882E 4.3.4 · Causes are the causal factors of every hazard that names the subsystem; subsystem-level failure modes beyond the hazard records are not yet analysed.

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · BMS = battery management system · CF1, CF2 … = causal factor in a hazard record (CF1, CF2 …) · CL-nnn =

concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US Department of Defense · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · F-nnn
= system function in the item definition · FMEA = failure modes and effects analysis · GNSS = global navigation satellite system (GPS and similar) · GPS = Global Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard
record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface

(integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record (M1, M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11
May 2012, base edition) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SCN-nnn = CONOPS scenario (SCN-0nn nominal, SCN-1nn off-nominal) · SF-nnn = walker

failure-search family (sim/search) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging

and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN =

manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-SAF = independent

safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · SysML = Systems
Modeling Language (SysML v2) · SZ-nnn = actuator sizing study at level 2 (sim/mujoco/sizing.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
